en.headline: HKU medicine changes MBBS language bar from Cantonese to Chinese
en.dek: The faculty said 2027/28 applicants may meet the Chinese requirement in Cantonese or Putonghua, but Cantonese is still required before clinical work.
body: The University of Hong Kong Faculty of Medicine has updated admissions information for the 2027/28 Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery programme, replacing a requirement for “a good working knowledge of Cantonese” with “a good working knowledge of Chinese”.

The faculty’s frequently asked questions now state that applicants fluent in either Cantonese or Putonghua meet the Chinese-language criterion, and that admissions interviews may be conducted in Putonghua. The faculty said the wording change was intended to assess applicants from a wider range of backgrounds and was not a lowering of entry standards, nor aimed at any particular place of origin.

It also said the update does not mean medical students may use Putonghua instead of Cantonese for clinical work in public hospitals in Hong Kong. Students must have effective Cantonese communication skills before clinical placements and contact with patients. Those who are not yet fluent would be given language training and learning resources, the faculty said, and clinical communication would still be assessed during the course. The English-language requirement is unchanged.

zh.headline: 港大醫科入學語言改為良好中文 院方：實習前仍須粵語
zh.dek: 港大醫學院更新2027/28年度招生資料，中文要求改為粵語或普通話均可，但強調接觸病人前必須具備粵語溝通能力。
body: 香港大學醫學院更新2027/28年度內外全科醫學士招生資料，將原本「具備良好廣東話能力」的要求，改為「具備良好中文能力」。
醫學院常見問題頁面列明，申請人擁流利粵語或普通話即符合中文要求，入學面試亦可以普通話進行。院方回應查詢時表示，修訂是為全面評估不同背景申請者的綜合能力，並非放寬入學標準，亦非針對特定地區或背景的申請者。
院方同時強調，有關更新不代表認可醫學生在本港公立醫院以普通話取代粵語進行臨床工作。所有學生在臨床實習及接觸病人前，必須具備與本地病人有效溝通所需的粵語能力。入學時粵語尚未熟練的學生，院方會提供語言培訓支援及學習資源，並在課程期間評估臨床溝通能力。英語要求維持不變。
